description: The lexicographic order on \(B\times A\) has type \(\operatorname{type}(A)\cdot\operatorname{type}(B)\) for well-orders \(A\) and \(B\).
signature:
Ordinal.type_prod_lex.{u} {α β : Type u} (r : α → α → Prop) (s : β → β → Prop) [IsWellOrder α r] [IsWellOrder β s] :
  Ordinal.type (Prod.Lex s r) = Ordinal.type r * Ordinal.type s
